hypothesis: Phase2 neural optimizers failed to attain the feasible SOXX control. Test explicit benchmark-feasible global convex allocation with prior-only annual H5 mean estimates, actual transaction costs, and unchanged benchmark variance and economic qualification gates.

estimation.labels: SOXL and SOXX Open[t+6]/Open[t+1]-1; availability at t+6 open
estimation.features: 25 original market features; excludes three old forecast slots
estimation.annual_maturity: All selected H5 outcome availability strictly before model-year Jan1 America/New_York; train-only scaling and covariance
estimation.uncertainty: Joint response-major HAC5 Bartlett sandwich of centered ridge scores, unpenalized intercept, no small-sample multiplier. Conditional mean estimation covariance, not total-return covariance. One SEM radius is not a 95% confidence claim. Excludes ridge bias, regime drift and adaptive search uncertainty.
estimation.covariance: Daily expanding sample covariance from complete observed SOXL/SOXX open returns ending no later than signal-day open; same Phase2 implementation
estimation.risk_budget: Daily Sigma_SOXX_SOXX; no conditional volatility-budget change in this round

allocation.variables: x >=0 post-fee asset values per pretrade NAV; n=sum(x); t>=abs(xRisky-currentRisky); n+cost*t.sum=1
allocation.reoptimization: Daily with five-session forecast; no forced holding period. Planning objective charges current transition costs and assumes no further H5 trades, a rolling planning approximation assessed against actual daily costs.
allocation.solver: CLARABEL; gap_abs/gap_rel/feas tolerance1e-10; numerical audit tolerance1e-8; independent actual accounting and risk/null-objective audit, no invented dual gap
allocation.failure: Invalid forecasts (nonfinite or <=-1) abort the complete run; never clip/drop observations. A solver failure may use explicitly labeled feasible-null fallback for accounting, but any unverified optimality fails qualification. Only roundoff cleanup with full revalidation is permitted.

training.deterministic: Three genuinely fresh annual fits and complete solves. No stochastic seed evidence. All predictions, targets, objective values and settled paths must match absolute tolerance1e-8 across all3. No fitting cache across repeats.

evaluation.benchmark: 100percent SOXX fee-funded buyhold; identical dates, marks and funding
economic_gates: positive cumulative net log excess both costs
anchored MaxDD and exact-tail CVaR5 no worse SOXX
evaluation.reproducibility: Require all3 repeated fits/paths identical within1e-8 plus positive excess each repeat at both costs; repeats are not independent evidence and never pooled for bootstrap.
evaluation.selection: Seal all development-only gates and ranking before post2022signal portfolios; choose highest worstcost/block bound among passers; diagnostic rank ifnonepass. No outer tuning.
evaluation.history: All historical dates previously inspected. Family10 correction covers only three explicit rounds and does not correct all prior adaptive research. Fresh forward evidence required for objective completion.
evaluation.native_qlib: Reconcile chosen development portfolio at both costs against native Qlib open-price execution
evaluation.numerical_excess_guard: Cumulative log excess must exceed1e-8 at both costs; effects within solver/reproduction tolerance are not measurable excess. This is an added numerical validity guard, not a return target.

continuation.if_no_qualification: Diagnose distinct information/risk/turnover mechanism; preregister next test. A failed batch is not objective completion.
continuation.if_historical_qualification: Freeze full strategy and collect new independent forward evidence before stable-forward claim.
